d:
Anant sinh ka bara khulasa: 'dularchand yadav kes hi hai bagavat ki vajah!' janie kyon niraj kumar ke khilaph khola morcha?
Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ke din in dinon thik nahin chal rahe hain! ek taraph MLC chunav men unka samarthit ummidvar anuj sinh har gaya, parti (JDU) se unhen bahar ka rasta dikha diya gaya, unki vidhayki aur sarkari bangle par sankat mandra raha hai... to dusri taraph ab dularchand yadav hatyakand men unki jamanat radd karane ki talvar latak gaee hai.
